order: Make the guard hook read the session's model before deciding whether to deny a tool call. Enforce only for director models; every other model stands the guard down entirely, with no partial enforcement in between. Resolve an undetermined model to enforce rather than to stand-down, so the harness cannot silently vanish for an actual director session. Read only the latest non-sidechain assistant model from the transcript, using a fixed-cost tail read, and skip sidechain entries so a finished scout run under a different model is not mistaken for the session's own model. Read the latest turn alone, so a mid-session model switch is honored immediately rather than on a stale cached value. Run detection on the would-deny path and nowhere else, adding no cost to an allowed call. Update the docs to describe the new behavior in full.
claims: Detection runs only on the would-deny path, so allowed calls pay nothing extra; measured at roughly zero added time over the existing spawn cost on an 8.8MB transcript, using a fixed-cost tail read. The guard now enforces only for director models and stands down entirely for any other model, with an undetermined model still resolving to enforce. The diff touches three files, and the docs were revised to reflect the new behavior.
